sections.title: In brief
sections.text: A parameterized shape grammar describes Japanese tearoom floor plans.

sections.title: Question or aim
sections.text: How can one generative language accommodate several tearoom styles?

sections.title: Approach described
sections.text: The paper presents a grammar whose variable forms can generate different plans.

sections.title: What the abstract supports
sections.text: The author claims a general language covering a diversity of tearoom styles across four centuries.

sections.title: What remains unverified
sections.text: The abstract does not expose the forty-one steps, corpus size, parameter conditions or individual plan derivations. These have not been checked here.

sections.title: Why it may help
sections.text: This is a promising architectural example of variation within one design language, rather than a universal model of every Japanese building.
